subject: POC final-mile connectivity & MAP tasks for CareBridge evaluation
messages:
From: Sally Huang <sally.huang@carebridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Tran <alice.tran@carebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP close timeline + env details we need

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was pleased with the latency profile and the quantization options. We want to lock dates for the POC so we can present a clear timeline to procurement. Before we finalize the MAP, two technical blockers remain for our infra/network team:

- VPC peering: we need a high-level diagram and expected peer CIDR ranges.
- IP allowlist + static egress: can Redwood provide stable egress IPs (or a predictable pool) we can add to our firewall?

Also, Procurement asked for a short mutual action plan doc we can attach to the SOW. Can you share:
- Proposed POC start/end dates (2–4 week window)
- Owner for API key provisioning and org setup
- Any required network changes on our side and a point of contact for coordination

We have a tight close target (end of Q4). Appreciate a concrete playbook we can run.

Best,
Sally Huang
Director of Integrations, CareBridge
--
CareBridge | carebridge.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sally Huang <sally.huang@carebridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP close timeline + env details we need

Hi Sally — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a concise MAP and a network sketch (CB_MAP_v1.2.pdf, cb-network-diagram.png). High level answers below; I included owners and target dates so you can drop this into procurement: 

POC window: 2026-12-06 to 2026-12-20 (2 weeks) — target contract signature week of 12/06, ramping with a 48hr warm-up once keys are issued.

Owners:
- Redwood technical owner: Karthik Iyer (karthik@redwood.com) — network peering, VPC config, endpoint tests
- Redwood product/ops owner: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com) — API keys, quota, access roles
- CareBridge technical owner: Sally (copied) and Alice for network configs

API key / org setup steps (actionable):
1) CareBridge confirms billing contact & signs SOW -> Redwood will provision a sandbox org id (org_cb_2026) and issue scoped API key(s). Owner: Marissa. ETA: 24h after SOW.
2) CareBridge provides a primary admin email for org invite. ETA: same day as key issuance.

Network:
- VPC peering: Redwood supports cross-account peering to your VPC. We will share the peer VPC ID and the expected CIDR ranges in the diagram. Owner: Karthik.
- IP allowlist: For the hosted MAP we recommend allowing our managed-egress range: 34.120.180.0/24 (primary) and 34.120.181.0/24 (secondary). If you require static single-IP egress we can discuss a dedicated NAT through Dedicated / private deployment — this adds procurement time.

Attachments include: a) short MAP with milestones and acceptance criteria, and b) a network diagram with proposed routing. The MAP has explicit signoffs per milestone (env provisioned, smoke tests, perf validation).

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm the SOW signature date and billing contact so Marissa can provision keys.
- Karthik will set a calendar invite with your network lead (30–45 min) tomorrow for peering details and to exchange VPC IDs.

If those dates look ok we’ll lock the MAP and get the SOW attached for procurement.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alice Tran <alice.tran@carebridge.com>, Sally Huang <sally.huang@carebridge.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP close timeline + env details we need

Hi Alice / Sally — quick network note ahead of our scheduled call.

1) VPC peering prep: please have your AWS account id and the candidate VPC id (and CIDR). We'll request a peering from our side and provide the peer VPC id and route table changes. Typical sequence: request -> accept -> add routes -> verify connectivity. Plan ~24–72 hours for the routing window depending on change windows on your side.

2) IP egress: the two /24 prefixes Naomi shared are our managed egress pool for sandbox. If your firewall requires a named contact or justification text, use: "Redwood Inference hosted sandbox egress for POC - API calls to inference endpoints".

3) Smoke tests: after peering and allowlist, we'll run a 6-step smoke suite (auth, single-token generation, streaming response, embeddings hash check, KV cache verify, perf sample at 512 tokens). Please allow port 443 outbound to our endpoints.

4) Jump host / bastion: if your security team requires inbound testing from a named IP, we can stand up a temporary jump host for the window; specify maintenance window and we'll schedule.

I'll add the technical agenda to the calendar invite (30 min). Please forward the network contact email so I can include them.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Tran <alice.tran@carebridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sally Huang <sally.huang@carebridge.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP close timeline + env details we need

Thanks everyone — confirmed on our side. A couple quick replies: 

- SOW signature: legal aims to sign by EOD Monday 12/06. Billing contact: me (alice.tran@carebridge.com).
- Network contact: mike.roberts@carebridge.com (cc'd on follow-up, not on this thread for inbox hygiene). He will join the peering call.
- VPC info: sending Mike's spreadsheet in a separate email with exact VPC IDs and CIDRs.
- We have no requirement for single-IP egress for sandbox — the two /24 ranges are fine for now. If we later need a fully isolated NAT we will re-open procurement.

We downloaded the MAP and network diagram — looks good. Please include an acceptance checklist item for "end-to-end latency under 500ms p50 for 256-token generation" in the MAP; that is one of our internal gating criteria.

We will expect the org invite and API key after SOW signature — Marissa, once you provision, please mark the keys as "sandbox" and share the key id (not value) in the thread, then DM key value to my admin for secure handoff.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the call with Karthik tomorrow.

Best,
Alice Tran
Head of Platform Engineering, CareBridge
